envelope.description: Expose responsive admission progress across supported clients

body.title: Expose responsive admission progress across supported clients
body.summary: Wire bounded per-review worker progress/status into current MCP/RPC readers, daemon thread status, CLI surfaces and live VS Code/JetBrains review DTOs/renderers. Preserve method names, identities and artifact-review behavior; add only the approved admission-phase/diagnostic fields and rendering semantics.
acceptanceChecks: During blocked admission, progress/status respond without waiting for worker computation and report freshness, timestamps and unverified state rather than fabricated completion.
Code uses scope_preparation with task:null and unknown inventory represented by numeric zero plus explicit pending/unverified admission; design uses admission phase before its accepted plan.
Clients display Preparing review or technical admission failure, never successful empty scope; existing qualified/completed review views still decode.
Controller admission-to-assignment observation does not steal authority, restart admission or allocate another execution identity.
Current vscode-plugin and jetbrains-plugin IPC field names remain aligned; deprecated insrc-ide is outside scope.

tests.name: src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-worker-progress.test.ts: pending admission and cached progress stay responsive during blocked worker computation
vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/review-worker-progress.test.ts: admission DTOs render preparing or failure without empty success
jetbrains-plugin/src/test/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/review/ReviewWorkerProgressTest.kt: admission DTOs preserve unknown inventory and current review identity
